Scope: 44 ready-built factories of 900 m² each in 11 blocks (B1–B11), with external utilities, roads, parking and street lighting.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (225,786 man-hours in the P6 update). At the 17-Nov-2026 data date the project is 85.4% complete against 83.3% planned, 2.1% ahead. This week added 1.9% against 1.4% planned. The weekly report workbook was not uploaded this week, so the headline figures come from the progress presentation and the phase and block figures from the P6 update.

Ahead of plan, but the forecast finish slipped one day and no float is left. The P6 update finishes the project on 25-Feb-2027, nine days before the contract completion date of 06-Mar-2027, with zero float on project completion. Activities in progress rose from 74 to 165. The civil works milestone slipped another week in P6, to 08-Dec-2026, and mechanical works and testing and commissioning moved to 06-Jan-2027. The milestone for site levelling, local roads and parking has still not started and is again forecast for the data date.

Site photos this week

Six of the 20 photos uploaded this week. The photos carry no date, GPS stamp or caption, so they are described from what they show. The progress presentation of 17-Nov-2026 lists painting of partition walls in Blocks 2, 3, 7, 8, 9 and 10, high-bay lights in Blocks 4 and 11, window frames in Block 1, duct supports in Block 5, painting and office floor tiles in Block 6, and installation of the GRP tank and the fire pump. Most discipline milestones slipped again in P6 this week. Civil works moved seven days to 08-Dec-2026, 68 days after its P6 baseline of 01-Oct-2026. Testing and commissioning moved seven days and mechanical works six days, both to 06-Jan-2027. Electrical and architectural works moved three days to 02-Feb-2027, and construction completion and the project finish one day each, to 16-Feb-2027 and 25-Feb-2027. The contractual milestone for site levelling, local roads and parking (P6 baseline 12-Feb-2026) has still not started and its float fell from 6 to 3 days.

Data notes

  • The weekly report workbook (WPR #39) was not uploaded. The file named DAM3-05-11_WPR39_2026-11-17..xlsx is the submittal register, the .xlsx file is the procurement tracker (identical to last week's file) and the PDF is a two-week look-ahead. Planned values per phase and block, major quantities, the milestone sheet, manpower, invoice log and HSE statistics for this week are therefore missing, although the contractor's checklist marks every sheet as updated.
  • Headline planned and actual progress come from the progress presentation (83.31% and 85.44%). Phase and block figures were computed from the P6 update: each activity's physical % complete weighted by its budgeted labour hours. This method reproduces WPR #38's 83.53% from last week's P6 file, and gives 85.46% this week, 0.02% above the presentation.
  • Block B6: the 10-Nov P6 update has it 82.7% complete, while WPR #38 recorded 3.7%. This confirms that the workbook figure was an entry error.
  • The two-week look-ahead PDF shows cost-based progress only. It is not used here.
  • Risk & Issue log: RISK-001 gives ceiling gypsum board as 90% complete, but its notes say 70% complete with 10% remaining; the presentation gives gypsum board at 72.0%. The dashboard still shows 244 open risks and 128 open issues, against 5 open risks and no open issues in the logs.
  • The log names Engr Hamdi as MODON PM, the checklist names Hamdi Nassr as the contractor's project manager, and WPR #38 names Engr. Affat Al-Enezi as MODON PM.
  • Submittals: the presentation shows 157 shop drawings and 83 material submittals, all approved; the submittal register lists 252 shop drawings (2 code C, 1 code D, 7 under review) and 136 material submittals (3 code C, 8 code D). The register carries project numbers DAM3-02-009 and DAM3-05-009, and its first MTS replies are dated 2025, before their 2026 submissions.
  • FIRs: the presentation and register give 1,085 submitted and 84 still open, while WPR #38 gave 982 issued with 2 pending.
  • Safe man-hours rose by 16,440 for the fourth week running. The manpower and equipment figures in the presentation are the same as on 05-Nov-2026.
  • The presentation's gypsum board unit is "Item"; its quantities are in m². Its cover is dated 19-Nov-2026, two days after the 17-Nov-2026 data date.
  • The P6 project code is now DAM3-05-11_WPR39, but its planned start is still 14-Mar-2023.
